# tapectl export

[All commands](README.md)

Export encrypted slices to directory

```text
tapectl export [OPTIONS] --unit <UNIT> --to <TO>
```

**Options**

- `--unit <UNIT>` *(required)* — Unit name
- `--to <TO>` *(required)* — Destination directory
